requirements.text: POST /orders accepts customerId and one or more lines, each containing sku and a positive quantity.
The service rejects a line with an unknown SKU or a zero or negative quantity.
A successful request creates an order with status CREATED, calculates the line-total sum, and emits order.created with the new order identifier.

sources.text: create validates the customer and order lines, saves Order.created(customerId, lines), then publishes OrderCreated with the saved order id.
